title: Reconstruct and falsify historical trading evidence
objective: Apply the RND-0025 research baseline to Champion and M005, reconstructing only supported claims and testing known bias mechanisms without strategy optimization.
success_criteria: Historical claims are classified without fabricating missing evidence
One-sided clipping and temporal/portfolio failure modes are machine-testable
M005 performance reconstruction fails closed when execution-grade data or untouched test evidence is absent
stop_conditions: Any change outside rnd/ or to frozen/operational paths
Any new strategy search, parameter optimization, ranking or post-hoc tuning
Any broker/network execution, strategy/risk/sizing, merge, promotion or capital authority
